items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: Then I got a gig with Woody Herman in his small band

ctx.x: Yeah, I got busted, and I went to Riker's Island for four months. And I did that, and when I came out then I cleaned up. Then I got a gig with Woody Herman in his small band, and we went to Washington D.C., and some cat... Boy, I don't know, some cat was dancing with this girl and he stuck his hand out, and I wasn't looking at the floor, at the particular thing, and he hit me right in the chops, man...
